_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_copy_except.py. t_eacx_duplicate is Dack's Duplicate: a 0/0 that may enter as a copy of any creature, except it has haste and dethrone. t_eacx_mirror is Cursed Mirror: a mana rock that may enter as a copy of any creature until end of turn, except it has haste.

cards.name: Test Duplicate
cards.oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has haste and dethrone.

cards.name: Test Mirror
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {R}.
As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.
